params.1273: Smith a bronze helm for Isold.
params.1274: If you don't have copper and tin, you can get some more from the mine.
params.1275: If you don't have a bronze bar, you can smelt one from copper ore and tin ore.
params.1276: Left-click an <col=FFFFFF>anvil</col> while carrying a bronze bar. Select the <col=FFFFFF>helm</col> from the bronze smithing interface.
params.2225: Armour protects you in combat. If you practice your Smithing skill by making more equipment, you can learn to make armour to cover more areas of your body.
